not_covered: Nvidia's market value crossed $4 trillion on 2025-07-09, making it the first company in history to close above this threshold [Source: ev-1].

This milestone was driven by strong demand for its Blackwell accelerator rack systems (GB200/GB300), the Stargate project's approximately $500 billion AI-infrastructure plan, and repeatedly raised capital expenditure guidance from hyperscalers such as Microsoft, Meta, Google, and Amazon throughout 2025 [Source: ev-1].
Additionally, Nvidia maintained a dominant share of the AI-accelerator market during this period [Source: ev-1].
CEO Jensen Huang characterized this shift as a transition from training to inference demand, describing "AI factories" that sell compute as a commodity [Source: ev-1].
